name: What are the typical costs associated with designing and building an ADU in Southern California?

mainEntity.name: What are the typical costs associated with designing and building an ADU in Southern California?

acceptedAnswer.text: ADU costs in Southern California vary significantly based on size, complexity, materials, and site conditions. Expenses typically include design and architectural fees, permits, construction, and utility hookups. A basic detached ADU might start from $150,000 to $250,000, while more complex or larger units can exceed this. Consulting with a local contractor for a detailed estimate is recommended, as costs can fluctuate due to labor and material prices.
acceptedAnswer.description: ADU costs in Southern California typically range from $150,000 upwards, depending on size, design, and site specifics. This includes design, permits, and construction.
